theorems.name: Submission.measure_open_le_liminf_of_tendsto_integral
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (μs : ℕ → Measure (Euclidean N)) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)), (∀ (i : ℕ) (K : Set (Euclidean N)), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μs i K ≠ ∞) → (∀ K : Set (Euclidean N), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K ≠ ∞) → (∀ g : Euclidean N → ℝ, Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ U → Tendsto (fun i ↦ ∫ x, g x ∂(μs i)) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, g x ∂μ))) → ∀ O : Set (Euclidean N), IsOpen O → O ⊆ U → μ O ≤ liminf (fun i ↦ μs i O) atTop
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
